hints.title: Column Profile State Encoding
hints.text: Since m is at most 5, precompute all valid color assignments for a single column of height m.

hints.title: Verifying Horizontal Compatibility
hints.text: Two adjacent column color patterns are compatible if no row shares identical colors in both columns.

hints.title: Column-by-Column Dynamic Programming
hints.text: Iterate column by column from 1 to n, accumulating the count of valid patterns modulo 1,000,000,007.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Profile dynamic programming with precomputed column compatibility transitions.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Global grid backtracking suffers exponential state explosion of 3^(M*N).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since M <= 5, at most 3 * 2^(M-1) <= 48 valid column configurations exist.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should exploit M <= 5 by compressing columns into small state spaces.
